The incident highlighted the vulnerability of school transport during intense rainfall.

Both sides face immense human and financial costs in this attritional struggle.  Ukraine's adaptability and Western support sustain its defenses against Russian advances.  This prolonged war tests endurance and reshapes Europe's security order.

The Information reports the round would value Perplexity above $30 billion, up more than 50 percent from its last valuation, as annualised revenue climbs past $750 million on the back of its Perplexity Computer agent.

title: Delhi-NCR rain chaos: Capital under orange alert; WFH advisory issued for Gurgaon
description: Heavy rains lashed Delhi-NCR on Monday, causing significant waterlogging and traffic congestion. Authorities in Gurgaon issued a work-from-home advisory for August 25 due to the downpour. Several key roads and underpasses in Delhi also experienced severe water accumulation. Flight operations were disrupted, with fifteen Delhi-bound flights being diverted. Civic teams were deployed to manage the situation and clear waterlogged areas.

He noted that trade turnover between Russia and India has significantly increased this year.  External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar conveyed good wishes and discussed economic cooperation details.  Both leaders anticipate future meetings at upcoming international summits.  The India-Russia partnership demonstrates resilience and adaptability amidst global complexities.

Misinformation about fines fueled panic among drivers unable to speak Marathi. The situation normalized later in the day after police intervention.

title: Dhruv shines like a jewel in Colombo; makes the opportunity(ies) count

description: In a phenomenal display of skill, Rishabh Pant has outshone Adam Gilchrist's Test six record, achieving an impressive 102 sixes over just 52 matches, positioning him third globally. Additionally, he has set a new benchmark as India's highest run-scorer among wicketkeepers in away Tests, surpassing MS Dhoni's previous record. Furthermore, Pant leads India in the World Test Championship run-scorer tally.

title: ‘You don't know what happened’: After Maha cliff tragedy, aunt rejects iPhone claim
description: The aunt of a deceased teenager has released an emotional video pleading for an end to unverified claims. She stated that false narratives about the family's tragedy are circulating widely on social media. The family is already struggling with immense grief and distress from the recent deaths. She appealed to social media users to consider the family left behind before posting.

title: Mark Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125 million school to shut after 10 years
description: After a decade of service, The Primary School, a free private institution, has officially closed its doors. This decision follows the conclusion of financial backing from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative and the school's inability to meet state academic standards. As a result, approximately 540 students are set to transfer to the Ravenswood City Elementary School District, with the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative facilitating their transition and savings.

title: Mamdani’s team sends memo to ‘upset’ New Yorkers over million-dollar home tax
description: In a recent development, New York City's Finance Commissioner delivered a memo about the pied-à-terre tax that he could not present in person due to ongoing litigation. The memo specifies that the supplemental roll does not automatically create tax liabilities for property owners. To evade the surcharge, homeowners are encouraged to provide evidence of their primary residency. Notably, the deadline for lodging appeals has been broadened until September 18, 2026.

Alabama students turn old Christmas trees into Gulf Coast dune protection
description: Alabama's fragile sand dunes are being restored with discarded holiday trees, as students and volunteers team up to plant native vegetation along the coast. This innovative project marries sand trapping techniques with the introduction of native plants to stabilize the dunes. This effort not only protects essential infrastructure but also fosters crucial habitats for local wildlife, showcasing an eco-friendly method for coastal restoration and habitat recovery.
